claims.claim: The public EWA page describes EWA Investments Strategies as a Dubai business consulting and services company, founded in 2025, with 2–10 employees.
The ewa.group domain RDAP record shows registration on 06 May 2025; domain registration is not proof of company incorporation or licence.
Apollo links Haarish to an EWA CEO role from May 2025, but the public company page shows one visible employee, Keith Nettles, and does not list Haarish as an employee.
The EWA website does not display an exact legal company name, registration number, licence, owners, named team, client list or case study on the captured home page.
A February 2026 UAE Stories profile presents Haarish/EWA’s advisory, wealth-tech, M&A, family-office and India–UAE work. It is profile coverage, not independent customer proof.
No exact company-name POSH, sexual-harassment, police, court, lawsuit, fraud or scam result was found in the reviewed public searches; this is not proof that no complaint exists.
No named client, completed deal, portfolio company, independent case study or structured customer/employee review was found in the reviewed public search.
Altss mixes a Dubai EWA description with Pittsburgh and U.S. CRD 308977 data; the official SEC/IAPD page assigns CRD 308977 to a different U.S. EWA firm.
